6.0 REFERENCE:

6.1 NABH: Accreditation Standards For Ayurveda Hospitals 2nd Edition April 2016.

7.0 OBJECTIVE ELEMENTS

7.1 Scope of the laboratory services are commensurate to the services provided by the organization.

7.2. Adequately qualified and trained personnel perform and/or supervise the investigations.

7.3. Documented policies and procedures guide collection, identification, handling, safe transportation, processing and disposal of specimens.

7.4. Laboratory results are available within a defined time frame.

7.5 Critical results are intimated immediately to the personnel concerned.

7.6 Results are reported in a standardised manner.

7.7 Laboratory tests are outsourced to organisation(s) based on their quality assurance system.
